consumer_label.en: Read the complete source-labelled Papankusha mahatmya

scope.statement: Preserve Padma Purana 6.59 as a 28-verse mahatmya catalogue—not an invented plot—including reciprocal Shaiva/Vaishnava hell threats, accidental-fast absolution, fast/vigil superiority, health/family/wealth and thirty-relative promises, Brahmana gifts, poverty pressure, noble-birth hierarchy and disease claims without making them Devam facts, guarantees or instructions.
scope.time_scope: Locally resolved Ashvina Shukla Papankusha/Pashankusha; reviewed 2027 fixture 11 October
scope.source_expression_scope: N. A. Deshpande English expression and displayed Sanskrit of Padma Purana Uttara Khanda chapter 59; other recensions and reception unresolved

evidence_refs.claim_scope: Reviewed verses 1-28 with the complete Papankusha mahatmya catalogue.
Bilingual ordinary applicability, safe procedures, substitutions, closing and major variants.
